_: The songs the last fight can be cut to. Files live at the repo root or in music/finale/ (not in git). drop_sec is where each song's drop lands: the cut puts the first hit of the fight (or a Stomper's leap) exactly there. moods are what an edit strategy asks for; the default plays when nothing asks. words: how much narration the fight under it may carry (normal = two lines, few = one, none); soft_duck: the song is barely turned down under a voice (a feel song).

songs.feel: a feel song: the picture and the song carry it
